out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 4 DR stacked Traulsen cooler and 1 DR UPR Avantco refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Please provide temperature measuring device in the 4 DR stacked Traulsen cooler and 1 DR UPR Avantco refrigerator.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS instructed PIC to clean out the mop heads, rinse them, and hang up the mops to air dry.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed an employee did not wash hands after cracking raw shell eggs and before handling RTE food items.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS discussed proper handwashing procedures during food preparation. PIC removed gloves, washed hands and put on a new pair of gloves.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink in back kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels at handwashing sink at back kitchen. WAFFLE KING'S VIRGINIA KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 01/16/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: Observed ground beef stored above whole muscle beef in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC placed ground beef below whole muscle beef in WIC.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: a can opener.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC washed, rinsed and sanitized a can opener.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Observed not date marking for coleslaw in 3 DR UC at service area.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC understands all cooked/prepared foods kept for more than 24 hours must be date marked. PIC has date marked the aforementioned food items accordingly.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed oil stored next to chemicals.
violations.corrective_action: PIC relocated the oil away from chemical storage area and placed in a designated food storage area separate from chemicals.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed no labeled bleach bottle.
violations.corrective_action: PIC labeled the bleach bottle

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed oil stored directly on floor in dry storage.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved oil to approved shelving.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed knife stored between prep tops.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC cleaned and sanitized knife properly.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crates found used for storage of cups at the back of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. PIC placed cups on designated and approved storage racks.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Observed interior of all refrigeration units, exterior of stove at cook line, shelvings throughout the kitchen with accumulation of grime and food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please ensure continued correction and more frequent cleaning in the future to prevent grime accumulation.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls and floor are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Please clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, In Designated Room/Area
violations.observation: Observed employee belongings are in dry storage
violations.corrective_action: PIC removed employees' personal belongings from dry storage area and relocated them to a designated area away from food items.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ground sausage at 52F in 1 DR prep cooler at kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded ground sausage and moved another TCS food items, held in the unit for less than 4 hours to the WIC.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wiping cloth in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1 DR prep cooler at the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC discontinued use of 1 DR UPR prep cooler and contacted a technician during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed no hand soap at the hand sink in the secondary server area by the rear dining area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT EVERY HANDSINK NEEDS TO HAVE HAND SOAP AVAILABLE. PIC PUT HAND SOAP AT THE AFOREMENTIONED HANDSINK. WAFFLE KING'S VIRGINIA KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 03/05/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the DIGITAL menu are incorrectly identified: eggs, sausage, county ham, and Philadelphia cheese steak sandwich. The PAPER menu provided in the facility does have the correct consumer advisories. Upon discussion with PIC, paper menus are used more frequently.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE DIGITAL MENU DOES NOT MATCH THE PAPER MENU. THE ASTERISK NEEDS TO BE NEXT TO THE FOOD ITEM (IE: EGGS, STEAK) LISTED ON THE MENU AND NOT BY THE NAME OF THE DISH (IE: PHILADELPHIA CHEESE STEAK SANDWICH). PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer cans of green beans and mushrooms were observed being used as working containers for cooking oil on the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. STAFF MOVED THE OIL OUT OF THE CANS AND INTO A NSF APPROVED METAL CONTAINER. EHS DISCUSSED WITH STAFF THAT MANUFACTURE CONTAINERS CANNOT BE REUSED BECAUSE THEY ARE DESIGNED TO BE REUSED REPEATEDLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: Hefty storage containers used to store raw animal products in the 1DR upright cooler by the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC AND STAFF THAT HEFTY STORAGE CONTAINERS ARE NOT NSF APPROVED AND SHALL NOT BE USED. NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS ARE FOOD SAFE. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: black trash bag used to line shelving above the hot well.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS DISCUSSED WITH STAFF THAT THE TRASH BAG MAKE IT DIFFICULT TO CLEAN CREATING PEST HARBORAGE CONDITIONS AND SHOULD NOT BE USED. INSTEAD PLEXIGLASS OR OTHER SMOOTH AND DURABLE MATERIAL LIKE PLEXIGLASS CAN BE USED. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
